title: comptime evaluation cannot observe process state: process identity is unreachable
notes: specification/comptime.mdx, 'Determinism': comptime 'MUST NOT observe ambient ... process state'. Distinct from the-environment-is-unreachable-from-comptime: `process.env` is the environment-variable source and `process.pid` is process state, two separately named rows of the same seven-source list. Both reach the evaluator through the same ambient root, so the pair also pins that the refusal is of the binding, not of one member.
